stem: Which statement best describes evidence that a chemical reaction occurs as a cake bakes?

options.label: F
options.text: The water in the cake batter evaporates.

options.label: G
options.text: The cake rises as gas bubbles form in the baking cake.

options.label: H
options.text: The cake takes the shape of the container in which it is baked.

options.label: J
options.text: The water in the cake batter is used to keep the cake moist as it bakes.
